description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Grant Calcaterra (back) will be activated from IR ahead of the Eagles Monday night game against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Calcaterra has had some decent games in the past, but has primarily been a blocking/secondary tight end so far in his career. Rookie TE Eli Stowers is also making his debut on Monday, and he is much more of a pass catching threat. Both shouldn't be started in regular leagues just yet.
items.title: Grant Calcaterra (back) to be activated from IR, will play Monday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: The Carolina Panthers D/ST was run over by the Tampa Bay offense on Sunday, failing to record a sack or a turnover in what was a disaster of a day for the team.
items.impact: The defense struggled to stop Tampa, and the offense struggled to score against Tampa. There was little to write home about in this one, as the Panthers were dominated throughout. They'll look to bounce back against Green Bay on Thursday.
items.title: Carolina Panthers D/ST run over by Bucs

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Ryan Fitzgerald hit one of two PATs in the Panthers' 43-13 blowout loss to the Bucs on Sunday.
items.impact: Fitzgerald was held to just one PAT in what many thought was a decent spot for the Panthers, just another instance of the offense struggling mightily to get on the board. He will look to have a better outing on Thursday against Green Bay.
items.title: Ryan Fitzgerald quiet in loss to Tampa

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: John Metchie III caught two of four targets for 20 yards in the Panthers' 43-13 blowout loss to the Bucs on Sunday.
items.impact: This marks the fourth straight game where Metchie has caught multiple passes, though usually he's capped at about 20 yards. He's been operating as the Panthers' third wideout, but that hasn't led to much in most weeks. He's best left on waivers.
items.title: John Metchie III snags two passes in loss

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Mitchell Evans caught both of his targets for 39 yards in the Panthers' 43-13 loss to the Buccaneers on Sunday.
items.impact: Evans had his best yardage total of the season in the blowout loss, putting up his second 30+ yard game of the season. Evans is buried on the tight end depth chart, so don't expect this to become a regular thing.
items.title: Mitchell Evans snags two passes in loss

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Bryce Young completed 14-of-27 passes for 163 yards with a touchdown and two picks and a fumble in the Panthers' 43-13 loss to the Bucs on Sunday. He also ran once for nine yards.
items.impact: Young had his worst game of the season in this one, with his top two receivers, Tetairoa McMillan and Jalen Coker, held to just five catches for 49 yards combined. He better shake off this loss quickly, as the Panthers face off against the Packers on Thursday night.
items.title: Bryce Young struggles in loss to Bucs

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Taylor Moton (leg) was placed on IR after exiting Sunday's loss to the Buccaneers due to injury.
items.impact: Moton was diagnosed with a fractured left fibula after further testing on Monday. The veteran tackle will miss at least the next four games, but potentially longer. Rookie lineman Monroe Freeling replaced Moton in Sunday's game.
items.title: Taylor Moton (leg) lands on IR

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Dillon Gabriel (back) was activated from IR on Monday.
items.impact: Gabriel had been progressing at practice last week, taking reps with the Browns' second team. He'll now enter the mix with fellow second-year QB Shedeur Sanders on the Browns' depth chart behind starter Deshaun Watson.
items.title: Dillon Gabriel (back) returns from IR

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Eli Stowers (quad/hamstring) will be activated from IR today and play in the Eagles Monday night game against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Stowers has yet to play in 2026 due to injuries sustained in the preseason. The rookie second round pick will now make his season debut, and look to make an impact for a struggling Eagles roster.
items.title: Eli Stowers (quad/hamsting) to be activated from IR, will play on Monday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Daniel Jones is still the Colts starter, per HC Shane Steichen.
items.impact: Jones has been downright abysmal this season, throwing just four touchdown passes to seven interceptions, with only one passing touchdown in the last four games. His rushing hasn't been there for him either, as he's only had one score on the ground and is averaging fewer than 10 rushing yards per game this season. Rumblings will build for the team to give Anthony Richardson or some other name a shot if things continue to spiral, Steichen is likely coaching for his job, and Jones is playing for his job at this point as well. He's the QB28 on the season, but the QB37 in PPG among QBs with multiple games under their belt. He's not startable in any league at this point.
items.title: Daniel Jones backed by HC Steichen, still Colts starter

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Stefon Diggs reportedly won't see a larger role due to the injury to Terry McLaurin, per HC Dan Quinn. The absence of the star receiver will be made up for by others, with Antonio Williams being one of those named.
items.impact: This could easily be coach speak as the Commanders certainly need Diggs' help with McLaurin out. However, the naming of Antonio Williams was a pleasant surprise, as the rookie has flashed when given the opportunity to perform. He's a fun name to watch as the season moves on.
items.title: Stefon Diggs won't see bigger role due to Terry McLaurin injury

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Rashid Shaheed (knee) received positive news regarding his knee injury with the early testing showing that it seems to be minor. Shaheed left Monday nights game against Kansas City early on and did not return.
items.impact: It's good news for Shaheed that it seems like he will only miss a few weeks at most. However, if he misses time, Cooper Kupp seems next in line for targets, but AJ Barner also stepped up in his absence as well. Tory Horton appeared to take over return duties, and he could see additional snaps as well.
items.title: Rashid Shaheed (knee) knee injury seemingly minor

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Jadarian Price (chest) will have his 21-day practice window opened this week as he prepares to come off of IR.
items.impact: Price's addition, combined with the hopeful return of Zach Charbonnet, will greatly improve Seattle's run game. True, they've made it work with Emanuel Wilson and George Holani, but you know they would rather have their first round investment taking snaps and getting experience.
items.title: Jadarian Price (chest) will have 21-day practice window opened this week

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Charles Cross (ankle) is expected to be out between 1-2 weeks with a high ankle sprain. His availability will depend on how his rehab goes.
items.impact: The 25 year old is an anchor in the Seahawks offensive line and his absence will surely be felt. They'll have to make things work in the meantime, and help is on the way in the form of Zach Charbonnet and Jadarian Price to help out the running game, putting less pressure on the O-Line from constantly pass blocking.
items.title: Charles Cross (ankle) out for 1-2 weeks with ankle sprain

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Darren Waller caught one of two targets for a 50-yard touchdown in the Panthers' 43-13 loss to the Buccaneers on Sunday,
items.impact: If you have to only catch one ball, you might as well make it count. Waller rewarded those who started him with a long 50-yard score before going silent for the rest of the way. He's a risky start in fantasy despite some initial optimism for his role,
items.title: Darren Waller catches long TD in loss to Tampa

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Jalen Coker caught just one of four targets for nine yards in the Panthers' 43-13 loss to the Buccaneers on Sunday.
items.impact: Coker was coming in on a hot streak and went ice cold in this game. Everyone has a bad day, and the Carolina offense at large failed to do much at all, so it's not like Coker was the only one on the struggle bus. He will look to have a bounce-back night against the Packers on Thursday.
items.title: Jalen Coker goes quiet in loss to Tampa

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Tetairoa McMillan caught four of six targets for 40 yards in the Panthers' 43-13 loss to Tampa Bay on Sunday.
items.impact: McMillan was largely held in check all day by the Tampa defense, as was the rest of the Carolina offense. It wasn't a great showing by the young receiver, but it didn't sink your week. He will look to improve on those numbers against the Packers on TNF.
items.title: Tetairoa McMillan catches four passes in loss

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Chuba Hubbard ran seven times for 33 yards and caught four of five targets for 27 yards in the Panthers' 43-13 loss to Tampa Bay on Sunday.
items.impact: Hubbard was actually fairly efficient on the ground, the game just got away from Carolina so quickly that he didn't receive many touches. He was greatly helped by his receiving work in PPR formats, with his four receptions tied for the most on the team. He will look to have a better night against the Packers on Thursday.
items.title: Chuba Hubbard saved by receiving work in loss to Tampa

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers D/ST racked up five sacks, two interceptions, two fumble recoveries, and a defensive touchdown in the Bucs' dominant 43-13 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
items.impact: The Bucs' defense didn't even let the Panthers make this a contest, holding them to 13 points while also scoring some points of their own. It was an impressive showing by the unit, which now gets to face the Falcons next week.
items.title: Tampa Bay Buccaneers D/ST rattle Panthers in win

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Chase McLaughlin made both of his field goal attempts and all five of his PATs in the Bucs' resounding 43-13 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
items.impact: McLaughlin has been on fire this year, with nine or more kicking points in five of the Bucs seven contests. It's been a great start for the veteran kicker, who has not missed a single field goal or PAT this year.
items.title: Chase McLaughlin racks up 11 kicking points in win

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Jaylin Noel (toe) is still having his toe injury evaluated to find the extend of his injury, per HC DeMeco Ryans.
items.impact: Noel left the Texans game against the Giants early on, and did not return due to turf toe. It's likely he will miss at least a week, and possibly more, but fantasy managers will have to wait for additional news to come out to be certain.
items.title: Jaylin Noel (toe) toe injury still being evaluated

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Zaire Franklin (leg) suffered a hairline fracture in his leg but is expected to miss minimal time, hence why the team elected to not put him on IR.
items.impact: While it's unfortunate for the Green Bay defense that should be getting Micah Parsons back soon, it's still good news that Franklin shouldn't be out for long. Once he and Parsons return, this could be a very fun and scary defensive unit.
items.title: Zaire Franklin (leg) expected to miss minimal time with leg injury

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) is labeled "day-to-day" with his knee injury that isn't seen as significant.
items.impact: Jones left the Vikings game against the Colts early due to the injury, leaving fresh off of IR Jordan Mason to handle the workload. Mason produced well in the win, and should be in line for more touches should Jones be out next week.
items.title: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) day-to-day with knee injury

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Michael Mayer caught all three of his targets for 32 yards in the Raiders' 35-21 loss to the Rams in Week 7.
items.impact: Mayer has seen inconsistent involvement in the Las Vegas passing attack of late, receiving three targets or less in three of his last five contests. The tight end remains difficult to trust in all formats as long as Brock Bowers remains healthy, with a Week 8 contest against the New York Jets up next.
items.title: Michael Mayer catches three passes in Week 7

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: The Packers' D/ST logged two fumble recoveries and one sack while allowing 20 points in Sunday's loss to the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Green Bay's defense played pretty well on Sunday. They slowed down Detroit's elite offense and limited them to just 20 points on the day, and they were also able to log some big plays to help out their own offense. This unit has a short week coming up, with a matchup against the Panthers happening on Thursday night football in Week 8.
items.title: Packers D/ST forces two turnovers Sunday
